senses.zh_definition: 见于马来语字幕署名的网络名称；没有可核实的普通马来语词义。
senses.en_definition: An online handle appearing in Malay subtitle credits; no verified common-word meaning is established.
senses.ms_definition: Nama pengguna yang muncul dalam kredit sari kata bahasa Melayu; bukan kata umum bahasa Melayu yang telah disahkan.
senses.nuances: noun 仅标示专名用途。字幕预览直接出现 Sarikata oleh: ghiqrandal；据此判断为署名，不应标为 official 词条。原始证据见 [Southpaw 字幕署名](https://isubtitles.org/southpaw/malay-subtitles/834047)。以下是署名表达，不是普通词汇的高频搭配。

etymology.historical_story: Subtitle credits provide the relevant trail: ghiqrandal appears as a creator name rather than a word in dialogue. This supports treating it as an online handle. Its creator's intended meaning and pronunciation remain unverified. A possible explanation for its frequency rank is that subtitle credits entered the source corpus, but that corpus history has not been established. See [the subtitle preview](https://isubtitles.org/southpaw/malay-subtitles/834047).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 sari kata oleh，先想“字幕由谁制作”：ghiqrandal 在这里是署名，不是需要背诵释义的普通词。
